answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the cipher until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the quill of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing.
